scripts.dev: concurrently --names frontend,backend --prefix-colors cyan,green --prefix "[{name}]" "bun run --silent --cwd frontend dev" "bun run --silent --cwd backend dev"
scripts.build: bun run --cwd frontend build && bun run --cwd backend build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd frontend typecheck && bun run --cwd backend typecheck
scripts.lint: bun run --cwd frontend lint && bun run --cwd backend lint
